headline.text: ML4 gondola cleaning incomplete — fault prevented full rotation, some parts *uncleaned* at shift close.

summary: Two sanitation gaps on L3 ML4: gondola fault left portions uncleaned, depositors 1 & 4 tops skipped by shutdown crew. L3 ML1 worn C7 cleaning-roller replaced — potential debris risk caught during belt inspection.

food_safety.title: Worn cleaning roller replaced on ML1
food_safety.summary: C7 roller on cleaning belt found worn during inspection at 15:42; maintenance replaced immediately — worn roller could shed debris into product zone.
food_safety.status: Resolved — new roller installed at 15:45, belt running satisfactory.

quality.title: MM3 printer freeze on S3
quality.summary: Printer froze at 17:27, operator stopped immediately; reset completed and QA verified lot code and BBD before resuming.
quality.status: Resolved — printer operational, lot code verification passed.

quality.title: Damaged mold caught before use on ML1
quality.summary: Operator noticed damage on mold during pre-use inspection at 16:52; mold discarded and IMS notified to remove from system.
quality.status: Resolved — mold removed from service, system updated.

quality.title: Hopper sensor damaged during overnight cleaning on ML1
quality.summary: Sensor damaged during overnight disassembly, replaced by maintenance; sensitivity may require adjustment for correct operation.
quality.status: Resolved — new sensor installed, sensitivity flagged for startup verification.

sanitation.title: ML4 depositors 1 & 4 tops not cleaned by shutdown crew
sanitation.summary: Second shift found depositor tops skipped during first shift shutdown; these surfaces should be cleaned by the crew that shuts down.
sanitation.status: Flagged to Quality Managers for crew follow-up Monday.

sanitation.title: ML4 gondola cleaning incomplete due to fault
sanitation.summary: Machine fault during level 2 clean prevented full slat rotation at 04:37; QA reports gondola not cleaned in entirety, some parts left uncleaned.
sanitation.status: Open — fault unresolved at window close, gondola clean incomplete for startup.

opportunities.text: Consider adding cleaning-roller condition check to ML1 belt inspection startup checklist — today's worn C7 roller caught during cleaning may indicate wear pattern worth monitoring.
Review ML4 shutdown checklist execution with first shift — depositors 1 & 4 tops were skipped, and electrical cabinets were opened/turned off without handoff, delaying second shift startup.
